text:
contains
Description
Tests if one string contains another string
Syntax
<
string1
>
contains
<
string2
>
<string1> contains <string2>
Tests if string2 is contained within string1 using a case-sensitive
search.
The above example is equivalent to the
TCL string match
command
:
string
match
*
string2
*
string1
Note: The ‘contains’ operator does not support wildcards. It simply
compares two strings to see if the second is a substring of the
first.
Examples
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
# case sensitive
if
{
[
HTTP
::
uri
]
contains
"aol"
}
{
pool
aol_pool
}
else
{
pool
all_pool
}
# case insensitive
if
{
[
string
tolower
[
HTTP
::
uri
]]
contains
"aol"
}
{
pool
aol_pool
}
else
{
pool
all_pool
}
}
